name: Kazoku Kankin ~Aisai Sayaka, Naraku no Soko no Kairaku Ningyou~
original_name: 家族監禁～愛妻さやか、奈落の底の快楽人形～
source:
Yukiteru Yokoi, a second-year employee still wet behind the ears, is assigned to a new project alongside his boss, Shoutarou Okabe.
But the project falls apart, and a series of mishaps leaves Yukiteru and his boss cornered. They’re hauled into a disciplinary hearing, punished, and ultimately fired.

Six months later…
The stain of causing massive losses follows Yukiteru everywhere. No new job, unemployment benefits dried up, and now homeless, he wanders the streets.
One day, he happens to pass by his old company. From the entrance emerges his former boss, Shoutarou Okabe.

They were both fired together, weren’t they?
But now, Okabe has risen to become an executive.
Yukiteru starts digging into Okabe’s life and uncovers the truth: he was made the scapegoat.

While Yukiteru suffers in misery, Okabe lives in comfort.
How could he not feel hatred?
With relentless determination, Yukiteru tracks down Okabe’s home.
Dark resentment fills him, driving him to action…

On a weekend afternoon, Yukiteru storms Okabe’s house with a group of homeless companions.
He captures and ties up Okabe and his wife, kicking off a twisted feast of despair for Okabe—and revenge for Yukiteru.

[Translated from [url=http://tsumami.kannaduki.jp/soft/005_kazokukankin1/index.html#STORY]the official website[/url]]
translation:
横井幸辉是一名入职第二年的年轻职员。他与上司冈部正太郎一起被派往一个新项目。
然而项目失败，一连串意外让幸辉与上司陷入绝境。两人被送上纪律听证会，受到处分，最终遭到解雇。

六个月后…
造成巨额损失的污点始终纠缠着幸辉。他找不到新工作，失业救济也已用尽，如今无家可归，只能流浪街头。
一天，他偶然经过以前的公司。昔日上司冈部正太郎从入口走了出来。

他们当初不是一起被解雇了吗？
但如今，冈部竟已升任高管。
幸辉开始调查冈部的生活，并揭开真相：自己只是替罪羊。

幸辉在苦难中挣扎，冈部却过着舒适生活。
他怎能不心怀仇恨？
幸辉以执拗的决心找到冈部的住所。
阴暗的怨恨充斥心头，驱使他采取行动…

一个周末的下午，幸辉带着一群无家可归的同伴闯入冈部家中。
他制服并捆绑冈部与妻子，由此拉开一场扭曲宴席的序幕——对冈部而言是绝望，对幸辉而言则是复仇。

[翻译自[url=http://tsumami.kannaduki.jp/soft/005_kazokukankin1/index.html#STORY]官方网站[/url]]
